summary: @servicetitan/folder-lint 38.1.3 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Package declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (mangled identifiers `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, dictionary-of-strings constants) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime as a per-platform zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/<archive>.zip`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, `chmod +x`s it, and runs it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. The invoked `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing an obfuscator.io shuffled string array, array-rotation function, and character/index decoder — its behavior is opaque and cannot be inspected without execution. The package's advertised purpose is folder-schema lint configuration (types/enums) and has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to ship a 727KB obfuscated payload. The combination — obfuscated preinstall dropper, alternate-runtime fetch to sidestep Node-based tooling, opaque obfuscated payload executed automatically on install — is the canonical alternate-runtime install-time RCE shape and is consistent with a supply-chain hijack of this scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
